      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "It corrects silent false passes and test assertion bugs in P2P handling. As noted in commit 6cb4ce2905, `p2p_orphan_handling` assertions 'passed unconditionally regardless of node behavior because assert_never_requested compared integer request hashes against strings'."
    },

      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "It resolves a significant user-facing compatibility issue with GUI-generated PSBTs. The description highlights commit dba6a52b6d noting that 'defaulting to [PSBTv2] causes issues for existing users' in the GUI, necessitating the revert to v0."
